metadata.dismiss_reason: last_output_at is a float written atomically by reader threads and read by the main thread for timeout comparison only. CPython's GIL ensures float assignment is atomic, and the worst-case race is reading a slightly stale timestamp, which only delays an idle timeout by one polling interval — not a correctness hazard.
